page.overview:
Who is Admiral Corby?

When Paris was overrun by the Nazis, Admiral Corby's nephew, Lieutenant Stuart Corby, disappeared. Spy Smasher found him the following year, still in Paris, running a Gestapo division.

After some violent misunderstandings were worked out, it turned out that for the entire time of his absence from America, Stuart had been acting as a double agent. " When Spy Smasher returned to America, Stuart remained behind again.

Admiral Corby was involved in a number of Spy Smasher's most famous cases.

entity.description:
When Paris was overrun by the Nazis, Admiral Corby's nephew, Lieutenant Stuart Corby, disappeared. Spy Smasher found him the following year, still in Paris, running a Gestapo division. After some violent misunderstandings were worked out, it turned out that for the entire time of his absence from America, Stuart had been acting as a double agent. By day he was a Gestapo colonel, and by night he was "the Apache." When Spy Smasher returned to America, Stuart remained behind again.

Admiral Corby was involved in a number of Spy Smasher's most famous cases.
